skill.name: promote-skill
skill.description: Guides safe publication of SKILL.md agent skills to uGig, sh1pt, GitHub, gists, and related skill marketplaces.
skill.summary: Package, publish, and promote SKILL.md agent skills across marketplaces.
skill.author: Hermes Agent

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, fenced CLI examples, placeholder URLs, and documented marketplace links. No prompt injection, covert exfiltration, or hidden execution intent was found in SKILL.md. The skill still handles public publishing, so authors should preserve explicit consent, secret review, and dry-run safeguards.

remediation.issue: Public publishing can expose local skill content if used without review.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation after the secret scan and before creating public gists, repositories, or marketplace listings.

remediation.issue: Third-party marketplace CLI commands may change or require authenticated accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run behavior as the default and verify command availability, login state, and target account before non-dry-run actions.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples trigger noisy automated security findings.
remediation.suggestion: Label examples as user-run commands and keep placeholders clearly non-secret to help reviewers distinguish documentation from executable code.

content.value_statement: Publishing a skill across agent marketplaces requires consistent metadata, clean source links, and platform-specific steps. This skill guides safe packaging, uGig publishing, sh1pt promotion, and follow-up marketplace submissions.
actual_capabilities: Collects required metadata for a public SKILL.md marketplace listing.
Guides a pre-publication secret scan and manual source review.
Shows uGig CLI and browser publishing workflows.
Describes sh1pt commands for cross-marketplace promotion planning.
Compares submission methods for multiple agent skill marketplaces.
Provides a final report format for published and manual destinations.
limitations: Does not verify that marketplace CLIs are installed or authenticated.
Does not guarantee every marketplace accepts the submitted skill or price.
Requires users to confirm public URLs and access controls before publishing.
May need updates when marketplace commands or submission flows change.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare My Skill Listing
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a first marketplace submission.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use promote-skill to prepare my local SKILL.md for a free public listing. Ask for any missing title, slug, tags, and source URL details.

prompt_templates.title: Publish to uGig First
prompt_templates.scenario: Guided uGig publication with source review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use promote-skill to publish this SKILL.md to uGig. Start with the safety checklist, then give the CLI or browser steps I should use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Promotion Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Cross-marketplace planning after a public source exists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use promote-skill to build a marketplace promotion checklist for my skill. Include uGig, sh1pt, GitHub, Goose, LobeHub, and Kilo steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Package a Paid Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for paid or gated distribution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use promote-skill to review my paid skill release plan. Check public artifact exposure, source URL safety, dry-run steps, and final report fields.

output_examples.input: Promote my existing GitHub-hosted skill everywhere practical.
output: A marketplace matrix showing which destinations use CLI, browser submission, pull request, or manual upload.
A dry-run oriented sh1pt plan for promotion commands and action-required states.
A final status report separating published links from manual next steps.

output_examples.input: Check whether my paid skill can be published safely.
output: A reminder to verify that public raw URLs do not bypass intended access controls.
A source review checklist for credentials, cookies, private values, and examples.
A recommendation to confirm paywall behavior from an anonymous browser.

best_practices: Run the secret scan and manually inspect every hit before creating public links.
Use dry-run or checklist mode until marketplace credentials and target accounts are verified.
Keep source URLs, listing metadata, and final report links consistent across marketplaces.
anti_patterns: Publishing a human gist page instead of a raw SKILL.md URL.
Uploading examples that contain real credentials, cookies, tokens, or private values.
Assuming a cross-marketplace checklist means every platform published automatically.

faq.question: Does this skill publish automatically to every marketplace?
faq.answer: No. It creates a guided workflow. Many marketplaces still require accounts, pull requests, or manual review.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: Does it handle paid skill releases?
faq.answer: It includes pricing fields and access-control reminders, but users must verify paywall behavior before publishing.

faq.question: Does it protect secrets automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends a local secret scan and manual review before any public upload.

faq.question: Which marketplaces does it mention?
faq.answer: It covers uGig, sh1pt, GitHub, gists, ClawHub, Goose, LobeHub, Kilo, Skillstore, FreeMyGent, ClawMart, Manus, VS Code Agent Skills, and Moltbook.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare a clean SKILL.md file, public-safe metadata, target price, source hosting preference, and required marketplace accounts.
